BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance,
is hereby amended by changing all the RS-3 Single-Unit (Detached House) District symbols
and indications as shown on Map No. 11-K in the area bounded by

A line 130.50 feet northwest of and parallel to North

Kennicott Avenue; North Kelso Avenue; a line 80.50 feet northwest

of and parallel to North Kelso Avenue; and the public alley next southwest

and parallel to North Kelso Avenue,

to those of a RT-3.5 Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage

and due publication.

Common Address of Property: 4606 North Kelso Avenue
